title: So disappointed.
text: So disappointed.. The materials all looks sturdy and heavy duty but once put together the drawers dont open and close, they keep the doors from opening. Nothing is aligned so its a fight to open doors and i cant put anything in the drawers. Even went back to make sure i did everything right and it is built exactly as the directions and pictures say to. So its a pretty non functional piece. Im working hard to stop shopping on amazon because of poor quality of stuff and especially clothes, plus rediculous prices but they got me again with this item. I sold my sold wood table and chairs for this. So disappointed.
